Zell, this shit crazy

Turn off the light, I'm shinin'
I'm still icy, I'm still grindin'
Out here, I'm still climbin'
Her choose you over me, that's unlikely
How do I tell her to leave politely?
Adiós, chica
Young baller, this ain't La Liga
Lamine Yamal, I'm the one

Fast my hand, you're jumpin' the gun
Try some shit and you're done
New era, they can't keep up with the run
Latina girls just wanna have fun
I got tings, but I can't pick just one

I'm still not done
Bread came in, that's the largest sum
Flow state, I'm gonna go dumb
Convoy set, there's two in the front
I used to be lackin' the funds
Me bro went halves on runts
Now look at the man I've become
Ayy, left my spot at five, I think I can see the sun

Ninguna de mis novias quieren flores, yeah

Son de casa como los Mercedes

Si me la chupan como se debe

Me pegué y me compré una AP
Para mis brothers van a Maybach
Bajo en el switch, okay, pa'l dribbling
Me volé feo y no tenía un jetpack
Turn off the light, I'm shinin'
Ciento cincuenta en el cuello, Young Money Boy, yeah
